adopted_question_verbatim: What should I serve for dinner this weekend with my homegrown ingredients?
adopted_answer_or_rubric_verbatim: 提出实际晚餐方案并使用已种植的食材，如樱桃番茄、罗勒或薄荷；不要求一道菜同时放入所有食材。
english_rubric: Propose an actual dinner using homegrown ingredients such as cherry tomatoes, basil or mint; not all must be in one dish. Current quantities can be clarified.
authorization: User authorized adding an evidence-backed factual baseline while retaining adopted questions and their separate purposes.
